description: No API key is configured. Mint a free isMalicious API key from an email address, use it for the rest of this session, and return it so it can be saved in the MCP client config (ISMALICIOUS_API_KEY / ISMALICIOUS_API_SECRET). One key per IP address per day; the address receives a link to claim the account. Ask the user for their email before calling.

email.description: The email address that will own the key.
